name: Dumbbell Stability Ball Side Bend
steps: Rest one hip and the side of your ribs on the stability ball and stagger your feet against the floor or wall.
Hold a dumbbell against your chest or extended along your top thigh while keeping your body in one straight lateral plane.
Lower your upper torso smoothly over the curve of the ball to stretch your top oblique.
Contract your top oblique to raise your torso laterally upward, then lower with control and switch sides after completing one side.
tips: Keep your chest facing straight forward so you bend purely sideways rather than twisting.
Move smoothly without jerking at the bottom of the stretch.
